payload.title: Auth: OIDC + SAML federation routes
payload.description: Port /auth/oidc/:id/verify, GET /auth/saml/:id/metadata + POST /auth/saml/:id/acs (SAML signature verification + replay protection via auth_saml_seen_assertions, migrated). TS: auth/oidc.ts, auth/saml.ts. Carry over the FR-214/215/216 SAML audit fixes.
